build_pg_agent: build a PGAgent policy gradient agent with actor and critic neural networks for continuous action spaces
build_actor_critic_nets: build the actor and critic TensorFlow networks using NetBuilder with configurable initialization output scale
train_pg_agent: train the PGAgent by updating actor and critic losses using replay buffer samples and advantage estimates
decide_action_pg_agent: decide an action using the PGAgent actor network with optional epsilon-greedy exploration noise
calc_updated_values: calculate updated value estimates from replay buffer rewards and discounted next-state critic evaluations
